meaning:
1) circle, circuit, compass
2) (BDB) vault (of the heavens)

elsewhere.note: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’
When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,
It is he who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them out…
